questions.question: Awake() is called before Start().
questions.explanation: Awake runs first in the initialization phase.

questions.question: FixedUpdate() runs at the same rate as Update().
questions.explanation: FixedUpdate runs on a fixed timer, while Update runs once per rendered frame.

questions.question: You can put a while loop that never ends inside Update() without freezing the game.
questions.explanation: An infinite loop in Update will freeze the Unity editor.

questions.question: The 'void' keyword means a method returns a value.
A GameObject can have multiple scripts attached.
questions.explanation: Yes, you can attach any number of script components.

questions.question: OnEnable() is called only once in a script's lifetime.
questions.explanation: OnEnable is called every time the object is enabled.

questions.question: The 'continue' statement exits a loop entirely.
questions.explanation: Continue skips to the next iteration; break exits the loop.

questions.question: You can overload a method by changing only the return type.
questions.explanation: Overloading requires different parameters, not just return type.
